newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Philippines to cut local fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippines to cut local fuel prices.

text.p: Caltex Philippines Inc will reduce petroleum product prices by an average of 32 centavos effective March 10, a top official told Reuters on Friday.
The official, who asked not to be named, said it will reduce diesel price the most by 67 centavos to 7.60 pesos at the pump.
"We have to match the lowest or Petron's adjustments otherwise we will be criticised," the official said.
The Caltex source said the company will decrease the price of kerosene by 41 centavos to 7.11 pesos.

While it will raise the price of regular gasoline by two centavos to 10.19 pesos, Caltex will lower the price of premium gasoline by three centavos to 11.27 and unleaded gasoline by two centavos to 10.88 price.
Liquefied petroleum gasoline price will be maintained at 7.8257 pesos, the official said.
The wholesale posted price of jet fuel will decrease by 44.4 pesos to 9.5781 and fuel oil by 14.14 centavos to 3.9429 pesos.
Earlier, two other refiners Petron Corp and Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp announced their fuel price adjustments.
The Caltex official said that the average reduction of the three oil refiners amounts to 30 centavos per litre.
Caltex is a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp, a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
